status: implemented and CPU reference-tested; selected only for exact pinned local artifact; unqualified
modifications: Re-expressed inference-only bidirectional BERT math in MLX; omitted dropout, decoder/cross-attention branches and unused CLS pooler execution.
Adapter pins artifact content, validates exact tensor names/shapes/dtypes, uses serialized WordPiece tokenizer with 256-token truncation including special tokens, masked mean and L2 normalization.

Embedding-only route uses existing exclusive adapter-operation admission and never constructs autoregressive generators or APCv2 state. It refuses generation and rerank requests; a separate pinned MiniLM sequence-classification adapter now owns task-trained reranking.

Host-only forward-start accounting keeps implementation/qualification/selection/use receipts consistent before, during and after failed execution. Per-operation observed use counts only forwards started by that operation, not earlier requests.

validation.kind: focused CPU functional/reference tests; not preflight or qualification

reference.implementation: locally installed Transformers 5.17.0 BertModel eager attention, torch CPU float32; cached pinned artifact only
reference.cases: Mixed lengths, Unicode/accent folding, Chinese text, whitespace-only input and right truncation beyond 256 tokens; exact WordPiece IDs and retained-token counts.

validation.integration: Actual ServingEngine/HTTP embeddings returns contextual trained vectors; generation, Responses, generation-tokenizer and rerank requests fail with 501; no APCv2 created; quiesce/resume and concurrent close retain operation ownership. Existing decoder embedding semantics remain covered.
validation.adversarial: Missing/extra/shape/dtype/offset/payload/header mismatch refusal, full payload corruption before tensor loading, generic BERT recipe drift refusal, no tensor/reference imports in inspection, zero/nonfinite/all-masked readout refusal, dimensions/input budgets and generation-option refusal.

validation.kind: focused CPU receipt/lifecycle follow-up; not preflight or qualification
validation.integration: Initial selected/unqualified receipt, validation refusal without use, in-flight forward use, failure after actual execution, later refusal without per-operation use, successful HTTP use and preserved lifetime use after shutdown. Existing decoder embedding and exclusive-operation behavior remain covered.

validation.kind: bounded public retrieval quality diagnostic on CPU
owned Apple M3 Pro MLX GPU artifact diagnostic; not preflight, performance or formal qualification
validation.details: Pinned embedding and reranker artifacts loaded with verified payloads under CPG generation 2027 and both GPU locks. Two embedding runs and two reranker runs were bit-exact; embeddings were finite normalized [3,384] with zero measured norm error; the relevant rollback document ranked first. Peak MLX memory was 216,332,953 bytes.

limits: An owned M3 MLX GPU diagnostic loaded and executed the exact embedding and reranker artifacts, but formal route qualification and controlled performance testing have not been run. CPU reference/HTTP tests and the bounded public SciFact evaluation are not broad retrieval-quality qualification.

Only the exact pinned all-MiniLM-L6-v2 bytes are accepted by this embedding adapter. Arbitrary BERT checkpoints, quantization, dimension truncation, reranking through this route, generation, streaming and APCv2/KV operations are unsupported; provenance/minilm-reranker.json records the separate relevance-trained route.
Inputs execute as independent width-one encoder forwards. This does not claim physical encoder batching or batched numerical invariance.
The existing decoder input-embedding means and cosine ranking remain separate unchanged contracts; they are not relabelled task-trained.

Embedding forwards are synchronous and are not interrupted mid-tensor-operation. Shutdown refuses callbacks that have not started and retains the adapter for active work; close uses the existing 30-second join timeout and can return while that owned worker finishes. No bounded execution-time or hard-cancellation guarantee is claimed.

artifact_binding.load_contract: Exact serialized recipe file hashes, bounded strict safetensors header schema, and full weight hash; MLX loads the same immutable bytes that passed verification. Tensor-free inspection labels payload verification false until load.
